applicable_rules.rule: Separate the mathematical statement, evidence authority, logical reach, and remaining boundary. New code is unelaborated; source inspection is not a fresh build, kernel check, or Comparator result.

Write self-contained statements with all domains, positivity assumptions, parameter dependence, quantifier order, and endpoint conventions. Never smooth away hypotheses or change implication into equivalence.
Use field-standard names and exact declaration identities. Give precise file/section/theorem locators and distinguish prior-art attribution from formal proof support.
Preserve the difficulty profile and explain the mathematical use of a new statement. Routine conjunctions and definitional wrappers repair correspondence; they are not separate discoveries.
Name the exact remaining proof obligation and the smallest check that would change its evidence status. Distinguish a finite ingredient from an assembled family or algorithm.
Keep mutable verification status in a source-bound receipt, retain AI attribution, and report exactly which prose, declarations, sources, and logs were inspected.

Apply genre-specific organization. This deliverable is the requested technical blueprint, so its ledger, implementation plans, status fields, and audit trail are appropriate rather than manuscript defects.
Use literal mathematical relations, restrained wording, and exact boundary sentences. Editorial fluency, examples, or another reviewer agreeing do not establish correctness.

scope_exclusions: Manuscript-only instructions to evict programme sections, choose publication units, rewrite an abstract/introduction, or prepare a rendered PDF are not a requirement to turn this technical blueprint into a paper.
